name: tisza_mayfly_bloom
theme: the Tisza 'blooming' — one June late afternoon when millions of Tisza mayflies dance in mating pairs over a green Hungarian river, as a full-scale dive where everything comes in PAIRS meeting: two honey-gold suns circling each other; the Earth with the green Carpathian Basin; the Tisza's meander loops meeting a second river at a confluence; the river in bloom as a crowded commons (mayfly pairs, sand martins, black terns, an asp slashing the surface, a white-tailed eagle on a poplar, a beaver lodge); one mating pair of mayflies; a wing's vein-walled panes; the flight muscle's striped fibres; the paired club heads of the muscle's motor proteins gripping their bead-strings; the atoms of one head; two gold nuclei flattened to discs meeting face to face and splashing sparks, which morphs into two colliding galaxies flinging tidal tails — two discs meeting at two scales. Palette family: Tisza clay & mayfly amber (jade-green river, clay-ochre banks, mayfly amber, dark poplar green, late-afternoon gold; deep indigo in space and the micro realm).

registers.name: twin_suns
registers.palette: honey-gold twin suns, clay-red and amber worlds, one blue-green world, deep indigo void
registers.scene: two honey-gold suns circling each other in the deep indigo void, a ribbon of glowing gas strung between them, their worlds set on wide shared rings, a clay-red world, a striped amber giant, one small blue-green planet streaked with white cloud wisps, a faint dust belt circling the far rim of the system, distant stars beyond
registers.loop_target: two honey-gold suns circling each other

registers.name: basin_globe
registers.palette: deep green basin, snow-capped mountain arc, clay-ochre plain, ultramarine seas, starry indigo void
registers.scene: the whole Earth from orbit in late-afternoon light, central Europe turned toward the sun, the deep green Carpathian Basin ringed by the snow-capped arc of the Carpathian mountains, a clay-ochre plain at its heart threaded by one winding dark-green river, ultramarine seas to the south, white cloud wisps along the coasts, the starry indigo void around the globe

registers.name: tisza_meanders
registers.palette: jade-green river loops, clay-ochre banks, dark poplar galleries, emerald oxbow lakes, amber sun glints
registers.scene: the Tisza river plain seen obliquely from a low aircraft in late-afternoon sun, a jade-green river coiling through tight meander loops between clay-ochre banks, crescent oxbow lakes cut off on both sides, dark galleries of poplar and willow lining every bend, a second clay-brown river joining it at a forked confluence, amber sun glints on the water, sunflower and wheat fields beyond the floodplain

registers.name: mayfly_bloom
registers.palette: deep jade water, clay-ochre bank, amber mayfly haze, dark poplar green, low gold sun
registers.scene: the Tisza in bloom on a June late afternoon, seen low over the water from the clay bank, a deep jade river and over it a dense living haze of millions of amber mayflies dancing in pairs, each trailing three thread-thin tails, sand martins and black terns swooping through the swarm, an asp fish slashing the surface in a burst of spray, a white-tailed eagle perched on a dead poplar branch, a beaver lodge of stacked sticks against the far bank, golden sun slanting through the dark poplars

registers.name: mayfly_pair
registers.palette: amber bodies, smoky-cream veined wings, deep jade water, low gold backlight
registers.scene: a mating pair of Tisza mayflies hovering joined in mid-air over the jade river, two slender amber bodies curving toward each other, four smoky-cream wings each netted with amber veins, three thread tails trailing from each body, the low sun backlighting the wings, the dark jade water and a blur of more pairs behind

registers.name: wing_cells
registers.palette: smoky amber membrane, dark umber veins, iridescent green-violet sheen, gold backlight
registers.scene: the membrane of a mayfly wing as a sunlit landscape, a net of dark umber veins dividing the wing into hundreds of small panes, each pane a cell of smoky amber membrane with an iridescent green and violet sheen in the backlight, rows of tiny bristles along the thicker veins, the main veins converging at the wing hinge where a ridged bulge of striped muscle anchors them

registers.name: flight_fibre
registers.palette: deep teal sheaths, coral and cream striped fibres, olive-gold mitochondria, indigo gaps
registers.scene: the flight muscle of a mayfly as living tissue, giant fibre cells laid side by side in a dense bank, each fibre banded with crisp coral and cream stripes, rows of olive-gold mitochondria packed in pairs between the striped strands, deep teal sheaths of membrane wrapping every fibre, indigo gaps between them

stage.element: a flight muscle fibre, a fat cylinder banded coral and cream inside a glossy deep teal sheath, olive-gold beads along its seams

registers.name: paired_heads
registers.palette: amber and clay-orange protein heads, jade bead-strings, deep violet gaps
registers.scene: inside one muscle strand, thick ridged rods bristling with paired club-shaped heads, every rod ringed by thin twisted strings of jade beads, each pair of amber heads gripping a bead-string, one rank of heads bent forward and the next rank bent back, rods and strings laid in a dense hexagonal weave receding into deep violet

stage.element: a myosin head, an amber club of carved resin with two slender clay-orange tails at its base, a jade bead clasped at its tip

registers.name: head_atoms
registers.palette: teal and ice-blue atom hazes, one gold heavy atom, white-hot points, deep indigo void
registers.scene: within one protein head, a coiling tangle of atoms linked into chains, carbon, oxygen and nitrogen atoms each a soft teal or ice-blue haze around one white-hot point, slender jade bonds joining them, one heavy gold atom seated in a pocket of the tangle, the chains coiling away into deep indigo

stage.element: a carbon atom, a frosted ice-blue glass bead clouded with teal mist, one white-hot spark suspended at its centre

registers.name: gold_collision
registers.palette: molten gold discs, white-hot fireball, amber and clay-red sparks, deep indigo void
registers.scene: two gold nuclei flattened into thin glowing discs meeting face to face, a white-hot fireball where they cross and a splash of thousands of amber and clay-red sparks flung outward in every direction, the two discs edge-lit gold against a deep indigo void

stage.element: a gold nucleus, a thin disc of molten gold with a white-hot core, its rim beaded with clay-red drops of liquid metal

registers.name: tidal_tails
registers.palette: gold and clay-amber galaxy cores, blue star-forming knots, deep indigo void
registers.scene: two spiral galaxies colliding in the deep indigo void, their two gold cores meeting face to face, each flinging a curving tidal tail of stars outward across the dark, blue knots of newborn stars strung along both tails, twisted dust lanes between the cores, distant galaxies sprinkled across the void

music_theme: a driving golden groove at a quick tempo, a deep kick on every downbeat, warm analog synth pulses and plucked figures in pairs answering each other, a bright wide chord over the twin suns and the green basin, a swirling dancing arpeggio for the mayfly frenzy over the river, tight interlocking pulses through the wing panes and the striped muscle, close rowing figures among the paired protein heads, and a rising swell on the gold collision that bursts into the colliding galaxies
